title: PAPERLIGHT poster
body:
PAPERLIGHT
Halden Softworks · 1999

A kid with a paper lantern, a red-and-white lighthouse, a sea the colour of ink.

I got this poster in a magazine when I was nine. I've moved apartments four times and it's come with me every time.

title: Note in the game box (age 9)
body:
SECRETS I KNOW

1. the lighthouse key is under the 3rd fence post
2. if you go BEHIND the lighthouse and press UP 3 TIMES there is a secret fox!!!
3. Danny says the fox is fake. Danny is a liar

do not throw this away

title: notes_dont_ship.txt
body:
Packed the 0.7.3 dev build into OLD before the handoff, so the new owners can't poke at the helper module.

Same passphrase scheme as always: CODENAME + the year it was packed (all caps, no spaces).

If anyone finds this: please don't run it.
— R. Okafor
